gates.text: Open a Frame / Fan out / Aggregate / Report checklist. State the done predicate, output artifact/report, exact coverage slices and whether the shape is partitioned, a race or mixed. Declare `first pass`, `rank all` or `best-of` before any race/mixed dispatch; do not change the selection rule after seeing results.

Resolve `swarm workers` (or explicit race-arm selections) with pstack_route, then launch independent native sessions_spawn workers with emitted arguments and bounded concurrency. Each self-contained brief names goal, scope, slice/arm, exact revision SHAs, verification and output. Measurement briefs specify sample count, what one sample means and run order; require those SHAs and that method in the result. Give writers disjoint writable outputs. Native local children are not cloud machines; use an authorized isolated native environment only when actually available.

Collect every run through its actual native completion path. Workers return PASS, ISSUES or BLOCKED with evidence, all defects they can prove, and every SHA/method required by their brief. An unavailable required worker is BLOCKED; no sequential parent pass substitutes for independent coverage. Record dropouts and inspect actual artifacts rather than trusting self-reports.

Reject a result that omits or mismatches any specified SHA or measurement method; retry that slice ONCE through routed native delegation with the failed contract named. A second miss becomes an explicit coverage gap, not a pass. Every required coverage slice needs a valid result; for races apply only the predeclared selection rule.

Merge findings, spot-check evidence and verify integration while preserving existing task owners. Return one consolidated table, issue one-liners, gaps/dropouts and the race rule when used, not raw worker dumps. Missing, failed or invalid slices cannot support a complete-coverage claim.

For long routed phases, spawn announcing children (without `collect`; a collector is collected in the turn that spawned it) and use a short bounded native wait, then hand off pending run IDs and finish on resume under [the shared lifecycle](contract.md#collection-and-resume); never respawn accepted children or claim pending work complete.
